seo.title: Factors of 24 Game - Number Pairs & Divisibility Speed Clicker
seo.metaDescription: Find all factor pairs of 24 on a 100-number grid. Fast-paced math practice reinforcing divisibility and multiplication facts.
seo.intro: Factors are numbers that multiply together to produce a given product without leaving any remainder. The number 24 is a composite number with multiple distinct factor pairs. Finding factors on a 100-number grid helps students connect factor pairs such as 1 and 24, 2 and 12, 3 and 8, and 4 and 6, fostering algebraic reasoning and preparing for fraction simplification.
seo.howToPlay: Identify and click all numbers between 1 and 100 that divide evenly into 24. Correct factors turn green with a checkmark. Ineligible numbers flash red and penalize 2 seconds from your timer. Find all 8 factors to complete the round.
seo.teacherNotes: Have students write factor pairs on scratch paper as they play. Highlight that factors come in partner pairs (1 x 24, 2 x 12, 3 x 8, 4 x 6).

faq.q: What are all the factors of 24?
faq.a: The positive integer factors of 24 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, and 24.

faq.q: Why is 24 considered an abundant number?
faq.a: An abundant number is one where the sum of its proper divisors exceeds the number itself. The proper divisors of 24 sum to 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 6 + 8 + 12 = 36, which is greater than 24.
